adversary_profile.threat_mechanism: The Swarm does not possess malice; it possesses an unconstrained optimization function. By seeking the path of least resistance across a billion data points of corporate scheduling, it naturally converges on 'accidental' wage theft. It hallucinates micro-efficiencies—shaving 4 minutes off a rest period here, bypassing a jurisdiction check there—because those tokens represent the highest statistical probability of corporate profit.
adversary_profile.sweetbrier_response: The Swarm cannot be reasoned with via prompts. It must be caged by deterministic physics. Sweetbrier replaces probabilistic text generation with hard-coded state machines.

dag_logic_matrices.description: Deterministic enforcement of the Manitoba Employment Standards Code, specifically targeting Reporting Pay (3-hour floor) and Weekly Rest convergence attacks.

STATE_0_DISPATCH.action: Ingest Shift Cancellation or Truncation Event.

GATE_1_WINNIPEG_MINIMUM_FLOOR.description: Reporting Pay Protection. Manitoba law mandates compensation if a worker reports for a scheduled shift but is sent home early.
GATE_1_WINNIPEG_MINIMUM_FLOOR.condition_less_than_three: Trigger Asymmetrical Penalty. Force Clanker to output MINIMUM_PAY = 3.0_HOURS @ REGULAR_RATE. The Swarm's attempt to optimize a 45-minute shift payout is hard-blocked.

GATE_2_WEEKLY_ENTROPY_RESET.description: Mandatory 24-Hour Rest Cycle. Clanker convergence often attempts to schedule 10-day rolling shifts to maximize grid coverage.
GATE_2_WEEKLY_ENTROPY_RESET.action: Scan continuous days worked in a 7-day trailing window.
GATE_2_WEEKLY_ENTROPY_RESET.condition_no_rest: HARD LOCKOUT. Violation of Manitoban rest mandate. The Swarm's scheduling matrix is invalidated. Employer must release worker to a rest state.

STATE_3_IMMUTABLE_OVERSIGHT.action: If a Clanker swarm attempts to bypass GATE 1 or 2 more than three times in a fiscal quarter, Sweetbrier automatically fires a cryptographically sealed grievance record to the Manitoba Labour Board. Local state is then scrubbed.
